features.quote: a stone with a basin cut into it

notes: s2f1: found in the western high part of the fortress; a basin cut into a single stone, shown as a small symbol 'Basin' inside the fort on Fig. 201 (0-15 m), so smaller than 3 m: pool_def no. Header 'Cisterns: none' recorded as an explicit absence (C2). No pits or graves.
